app.name: Desktop launcher
app.summary: Launch a desktop action with a custom PNG icon and a Home Assistant state.
app.target_hint: Optional: button, helper, switch or script. Empty uses the tile entity if actionable. Sensors cannot be switched.
app.icon_hint: Store PNG on HA in /homeassistant/www/Icons; enter /local/Icons/terminal.png here. Empty: fallback icon.
